name: A Bruin Cube Day 2022
information: This competition is hosted by Cubing Club at UCLA. If you are under the age of 18 by the date of the competition, your registration will not be accepted unless you fill out the following waiver: https://forms.gle/4V9qfmUBjZCZJFxMA This is a **series competition** with [Long Beach Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LongBeachSpring2022) and [Geffen Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeffenSpring2022/). You will only have your registration accepted for one competition in the series.
